speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Jersey Finger (Avulsion Fracture of the Flexor Digitorum Profundus).

Based on the mechanism of injury, the inability to flex the distal phalanx, and the resting extension of your finger, I am confident this is a torn FDP tendon, not pyelonephritis. The X-ray results I requested should confirm whether there is an associated avulsion fracture of the volar base of the distal phalanx.

DIAGNOSIS_READY_Answer: Rupture of the flexor digitorum profundus tendon at its point of insertion
